title: HPC / GPU Engineer
summary: HPC (high-performance computing) and GPU engineers run and speed up large clusters of servers and graphics processors used for simulation and AI training. They sit with research, engineering or AI teams, tuning parallel code and keeping job schedulers, nodes and networks healthy.
dailyDuties: Profile and tune CUDA and MPI jobs
Keep Slurm or LSF queues and GPU nodes healthy
Run benchmarks after driver and library upgrades
Help users fix slow or failing parallel jobs
Script node checks and cluster automation
Plan capacity for new GPU nodes

skills.expectation: Write, profile and tune CUDA code and multi-GPU communication
Build and run MPI and OpenMP jobs across many nodes
Run GPU clusters with Slurm, PBS or LSF, fast interconnects and parallel file systems
Administer and tune Linux on compute nodes
Read and write C or C++ for performance-critical code
Write Python tools for benchmarks, job reports and automation
Script node health checks and cluster tasks
Reason about threads and synchronisation on CPU code
Support distributed training jobs on the cluster
Package jobs in containers such as Docker or Apptainer
Track GPU and node health with dashboards and alerts
Provision and configure nodes with Ansible or similar tools

certifications.why: Helps where GPU jobs run on Kubernetes
